Mark Rutherford, Mark Rutherford’s Deliverance.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/mark-rutherford/mark-rutherfords-deliverance

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Mark Rutherford, the author, died 1913.

First publication of the text used: 1885 (SE colophon: 'Mark Rutherford’s Deliverance was published in 1885 by Mark Rutherford.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1885, before 1931, so the United States rule for works published before 1931 applies. The edition's rights statement below also states the United States public domain.
- Country of origin: every person whose words are in the text died in 1925 or earlier (the last to die did so in 1913), so the text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):

They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
